media:group.media:title: MOTTO® | Idea People® AI Film
media:group.media:description:
We set out to create a film that feels human, cinematic, and emotionally resonant—one that honors Motto’s legacy of championing visionaries. What sets this project apart is not just that it was produced entirely with AI, but that it feels authored, cinematic, and purposeful. We treated AI as an extension of the director’s vision, not as an end in itself. The discipline to say “no” to certain outputs and refine toward a unified aesthetic is what made the film stand out.
AI wasn’t used as a gimmick but as a filmmaking tool, expanding what’s possible in storytelling. By blending generative imagery, video synthesis, and traditional editing, we built a hybrid production pipeline that allowed for precision, scale, and creative speed without sacrificing craft. The film proves that when guided by taste and vision, AI can enhance, not replace, the art of storytelling.

media:group.media:title: MOTTO® | Ninjas In Pyjamas Rebrand
media:group.media:description:
Rebranding Ninjas in Pyjamas – Expect the Unexpected. Founded in 2000, Ninjas in Pyjamas (NIP) is considered one of the most influential and legendary professional esports organizations in the world with a fanbase numbering in the millions. It is most known for its history in the game of Counter-Strike where NIP’s first roster in CS:GO dominated in the game’s early stages. Today, NIP boasts world-class teams and players in the biggest titles in competitive gaming: CS:GO, Rainbow Six, VALORANT, and FIFA.
NIP engaged Motto to lead its 2021 global rebranding effort to support change management, drive ambitious growth goals, and inspire new fans. The rebrand not only consists of a completely new visual identity, but also a crystal clear brand strategy that provides internal unity, coherence, and focus for the business to rally around. The result is a transformation that positions NIP for relevancy and success in changing times.
